principles: Only real execution evidence can unlock provider-run phases.
Readiness artifacts must be provider-free and outcome-free.
Host labels and provider/model snapshots must stay separate.
The 24-task corpus can be read and bound but not changed.
A2prime sequencing must remain blocked until ③ A4 calibration exists.
drivers: M1 launch gate currently lists static blockers plus execution-derived blockers.
The user wants progress without an expensive false start.
The protocol forbids optimizing or expanding beyond real research-readiness needs.

options.name: readiness-only-artifacts-and-checker
pros: Clears the static M2 launch-prep layer without running provider cells.
Makes remaining execution blockers explicit and testable.
Preserves protocol order and prevents fake budget locks.
cons: Does not produce H-M1/H-M3 outcome data.
Exact execution snapshots may still need final provider-run binding in the next story.

options.name: jump-directly-to-phase1-execution
pros: Would generate real outcome data sooner.
cons: Risks spending provider budget before snapshots/task inventory/checker are locked.
Would mix launch prep with execution and weaken pre-registration discipline.

options.name: leave-m1-blocked-and-only-update-docs
cons: Does not give a machine-checkable launch-readiness state.
Keeps asking the same five-blocker question without a concrete next gate.

rationale: The readiness-only artifact and checker path resolves the real M2 launch-prep gap while preserving the protocol boundary that only actual M2-a execution can produce the A4 budget lock and A2prime sequencing proof.

preMortem.scenario: Readiness artifact is mistaken for Phase 1 execution approval.
preMortem.trigger: Status text says launch ready without distinguishing provider execution authorization.
preMortem.consequence: Agents may run expensive cells or claim outcome data prematurely.
preMortem.mitigation: Checker requires providerCallEnabled=false, formalPhase1UseAllowed=false, containsOutcomeData=false, and status text says M2 execution not started.

preMortem.scenario: Task inventory mutates the original 24-task corpus.
preMortem.trigger: Implementation edits experiments/recovery-runner/tasks instead of reading it.
preMortem.consequence: Results stop being comparable to v1 Table 9.
preMortem.mitigation: Scope excludes modifying task definitions; checker binds source hashes read-only.

preMortem.scenario: A2prime sequencing is falsely marked satisfied.
preMortem.trigger: A readiness artifact reuses M0 example budget locks or fabricated budget rows.
preMortem.consequence: A2prime could run before ③ calibration, invalidating H-M1 contrast.
preMortem.mitigation: Checker rejects sequencingSatisfied=true unless a real M2 budget lock with ③ calibration binding is present; this story leaves it pending_execution.
